about.metaTitle: About Us & How It Works — Overlay Picks
about.metaDescription: Overlay Picks is a verified tipster platform built on trust: locked and hashed picks, verified settled stats and closing-line value. Learn how bettors find tipsters and how tipsters get verified and paid.
about.title: About Overlay Picks
about.subtitle: A verified tipster platform built on proof, not promises.
about.missionP1: Sports betting is drowning in noise — screenshots, deleted losers and “100% verified” claims nobody can check. Overlay Picks exists to fix that. We give bettors an honest, evidence-first way to find genuinely skilled tipsters, and we give skilled tipsters a place where a real track record actually gets rewarded.
about.missionP2: Trust is the entire product. Everything below explains exactly how we earn it and how you can verify it for yourself.
about.bettorStep1Body: Explore the platform and leaderboard ranked by verified, settled performance — not marketing claims or cherry-picked screenshots.
about.bettorStep2Body: Every profile shows independently settled results, hit rate and closing-line value (CLV) over time, so you can judge a tipster on evidence before you pay anything.
about.bettorStep3Body: Subscribe to the tipsters you trust to unlock their live picks the moment they are published — timestamped and locked so nothing can be edited after the fact.
about.tipsterStep1Body: Complete identity verification and connect a payout account. Verification gates publishing, so subscribers know a real, accountable person is behind every pick.
about.tipsterStep2Body: When you post a pick it is hashed and timestamped at publication. The locked record is what gets graded — building a track record you cannot rewrite.
about.tipsterStep3Body: Picks are settled against real results and your stats — win rate, ROI and CLV — update automatically. Honest, consistent tipsters rise on the leaderboard.
about.tipsterStep4Body: Earn from subscriptions to your picks, with transparent payouts handled through our billing partner.
about.trustTitle: Why you can trust the numbers
about.trustIntro: This is where we want to win. Our trust model is designed so that a tipster’s record cannot be inflated, edited or cherry-picked after the fact.
about.pillar1Body: Each pick is cryptographically hashed and timestamped at the moment it is published. That proof means a pick cannot be quietly changed, deleted or back-dated — what you see is exactly what was called.
about.pillar2Body: Results are settled against real-world outcomes by us, not self-reported by tipsters. Hit rate, ROI and profit are computed from that verified history so the numbers you see are the numbers that happened.
about.pillar3Body: We track how each pick priced up versus the closing line — the single best long-run indicator of skill. Consistent positive CLV is hard to fake and shows a tipster is genuinely finding an edge.
about.pillar4Body: Tipsters must pass identity verification before they can publish. Accountability sits behind every pick, and picks are gated until a tipster is fully verified.
about.seeItAction: Want to see it in action? Browse the <link>tipsters</link> or open any tipster profile to inspect their settled picks and CLV history yourself.
about.responsibleBody: Overlay Picks is a sports-information, analytics and tipster-platform service. We take no bets, hold no stakes and are not a bookmaker. Picks and stats are for informational purposes only and are not betting or financial advice. 18+. If you choose to bet, only stake what you can afford to lose — see our <link>Responsible Gambling</link> resources.

support.title: Support Center
support.subtitle: Answers to common questions — plus a direct line to our team.
support.g1a: A verified tipster platform. Tipsters post picks that are locked and timestamped before kickoff and settled automatically from the result, so their track records can't be faked. Bettors follow the ones with real, provable edge. See <about>About & how it works</about> for the full picture.
support.g2a: Yes. We only collect what we need to run your account, and you can export or delete your data at any time from your account settings. See our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
support.g3q: How do I get in touch?
support.g3a: Use the “Contact us” form at the bottom of this page — pick a topic, add your message, and (optionally) your email so we can reply.
support.u1q: Is there a fee for bettors?
support.u1a: No — browsing tipsters, viewing the leaderboard and reading the free daily picks are all free. You only pay when you subscribe to a tipster to see their live picks.
support.u2q: How do subscriptions and billing work?
support.u2a: You subscribe to a tipster to see their live picks. Manage or cancel any subscription from <mysubs>My subscriptions</mysubs> via the secure billing portal. If a subscription is close to expiring, you'll see a notice there.
support.u3q: How do I raise a complaint or leave feedback about a tipster?
support.u3a: Open My subscriptions and use Give feedback on the tipster in question — you can leave praise or report an issue. This is available for tipsters you subscribe to, and our team reviews every complaint.
support.u4q: How do I know a tipster's track record is real?
support.u4a: Every pick is hashed and timestamped the moment it's posted — before kickoff — then settled automatically from the official result. Records can't be edited, deleted or backdated, so the yield and closing line value you see are real.
support.t1q: How do I become a tipster?
support.t1a: <signup>Create an account</signup> as a tipster and complete onboarding (profile, sports, pricing and payout details). Once set up you can post picks and get paid by subscribers.
support.t2q: What fees does Overlay Picks charge?
support.t2a: Overlay Picks takes a platform fee on tipster subscription revenue (currently 20%). You keep the rest of what your subscribers pay.
support.t3q: When and how do I get paid?
support.t3a: Payouts are processed weekly, every Tuesday. You can also request an off-schedule (on-demand) payout of your available balance from your dashboard — those are released once an admin approves them.
support.t4a: When you post a pick it's hashed and locked before kickoff, then graded automatically from the official result. That's what makes your record provable — and impossible to fake.
support.contactIntro: Have a question, a suggestion, or found a bug? Send it straight to the team.
support.emailPlaceholder: Your email (optional, so we can reply)
support.sent: Thanks — your message has reached our team.
